name: B10-0258/2025 (ECR) – Return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on European Union countries to officially recognise Russia's forced transfer of Ukrainian children as genocide. It condemns these deportations as war crimes and demands the immediate return of all affected children to Ukraine. It also asks countries to widen sanctions against everyone involved, to refuse to recognise Russian adoptions or documents for these children, and to cooperate fully with international courts, including the arrest warrants for Vladimir Putin and Maria Lvova-Belova.

- The Parliament asks European Union countries to label these child transfers genocide; no law changes yet.
- It affects deported Ukrainian children, their families, and Russian officials under sanctions.
- Next: European Union governments decide on recognition, sanctions, and cooperation with courts.
